verdict.rationale: The pack does not document any of the story's capabilities: mergeable scenes, text or YAML serialization, merge tooling, or a built-in version-control or collaboration feature. 'Collaborate and iterate quickly with your team' is a marketing tagline that names no feature. Build Automation's support for version control systems concerns CI builds, not whether the project format works well under version control. Both are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration
